Durable prior reviews were used to deduplicate existing findings. No tests executed.

effective_errata.source: §7.11.4.1, annotation on physical153; the affected bullets follow the NOTE on physical153/printed138
effective_errata.effect: Replaces the earlier EmbeddedFiles-only list with EF/RF embedded-stream routes and states the EmbeddedFiles name tree is optional unless another provision requires it.
Adds embedded-file references in those contexts; does not require all processors to eagerly process embedded bytes.
Narrows producer MIME syntax to RFC2046 section 2 top-level type/subtype representation; not a reader rejection instruction.
Specifies CheckSum's type as byte string; checksum remains 16-byte MD5 of uncompressed payload.
CreationDate/ModDate are intended filesystem dates if included, where supported by the host; no unconditional date-generation duty is inferred.

effective_errata.source: Table43 version metadata in prior FileSpec audit
effective_errata.effect: Adds PDF-version scope to a Table43 row; no new assertion gap in sampled attachment/name consumers.

cells.source: F is required when DOS, Mac, and Unix filename entries are absent; UF, when present, shall be used instead of F. Desc is optional generally, but Table43 says it shall be used for FileSpecs referenced from the EmbeddedFiles name tree. A tree key is not necessarily a filename.
cells.implementation: FileSpec::display_name prefers UF and retains the legacy filename/fallback; attachment listing keeps tree key and description distinct. The association between a FileSpec and an EmbeddedFiles tree remains a producer context, not grounds to reject other permitted FileSpec carriers.
cells.assertions: Current T132 exact-xref test uses distinct F/UF bytes, UTF-16BE UF and F-only fallback, and checks decoded selected stream; current test is in doc/reviews/2038-specification-audit/findings.json with 1PASS. Public attachment listing/extraction tests check actual bytes. No new T132 claim added.

cells.source: Embedded streams may be attached via EF and, after #481, RF; EmbeddedFiles name tree is optional unless another clause requires it. Embedded bytes are included for convenience and need not be processed directly by every processor.
cells.implementation: pdf-model attachment readers enumerate name-tree files, annotation EF files, and supported related/associated-file paths; viewer-core offers deferred extraction to host/user action.
cells.assertions: Current extraction tests distinguish name-tree attachment from a file-attachment annotation's own EF stream; durable file_specs_current and file_specification_remaining_current reviews cover routes and parsing. Avoid eager-decode or universal-listing mandate.

cells.source: AFRelationship is Table43 continuation at physical152/printed137. CI is optional but, when present, is an indirect reference in PDF1.7+. Thumb is a stream; EP identifies encrypted-payload handling.
cells.implementation: Associated-file model and attachment/collection consumers expose these values; the collection-schema fixture must use an indirect CI object. Thumbnail and encrypted-payload routes have separate bounded support.
cells.assertions: Prior associated-file, Annex K, collection and file-spec shards own these cells. No whole-Table43 coverage asserted here.

cells.source: Type optional (if present EmbeddedFile). Subtype and Params optional except required for associated files. #155 narrows valid producer subtype MIME syntax.
cells.implementation: Attachment parser retains subtype/parameters; stream decoding uses general Filter pipeline; writer emits Type/Params and optional subtype.
cells.assertions: embedded_files_spec_audit writes/reads exact Type/Subtype/Params; associated-file examples assert conditional producer contexts. No reader rejection is derived from Type or #155 producer syntax.

cells.source: Size is optional uncompressed size. Dates optional, except ModDate required for associated files. Mac is deprecated in PDF2.0. #598 qualifies filesystem-date intent by host support.
cells.implementation: Attachment carries stated metadata; collection uses Size/date values; host creation policy does not invent unsupported original filesystem dates.
cells.assertions: Size/dates are checked via the actual collection schema consumer and file-spec tests. Deprecated Mac and malformed producer entries are not reader rejection duties.

cells.source: Optional 16-byte byte string; MD5 of uncompressed embedded bytes; expressly not for security.
cells.implementation: Attachment::checksum_matches operates on supplied decoded bytes; extraction is deferred and owns decoded stream data.
cells.assertions: Existing raw-stream tests exercise digest predicate. Current T62 `embedded_file_checksum_is_checked_after_filter_decoding` uses a valid 27-byte Flate stream decoding to literal 19-byte payload and independent payload-vs-encoded MD5 controls; durable finding records PASS. No duplicate draft warranted.

cells.source: Optional; absent schema permits useful available-file defaults (MAY).
cells.implementation: Collection parser plus host presentation supports schema; flat attachment view remains when absent.
cells.assertions: Collections parser and panel tests cover presence/absence; absence does not impose one universal column set.

cells.source: Optional initial document key; missing/invalid selects container; unmatched valid key selects first file; empty name tree gives empty preview. A matched key identifies the document initially presented. PDF2 encrypted wrapper requires D to identify payload.
cells.implementation: Collection::initial_document resolves Container/Embedded/FirstFile/Empty; Query/host row emphasis marks the chosen item.
cells.assertions: Current `a_collections_initial_document_is_the_row_set_in_bold` covers distinct outcomes and empty case. D02 remains an owner interpretation question: Table153 says initial document shall be presented, while implementation emphasizes row and leaves container page visible. Do not call this an ISO failure absent resolved presentation semantics.

cells.source: D details all schema info; T icon plus subset; H initially hidden with explicit means to show and processor should display D; C PDF2 valid only with Navigator. Default D; encrypted wrapper requires H.
cells.implementation: Host maps Details/Tile/Hidden and supported Navigator modes; split/preview policy is separate.
cells.assertions: Model tests distinguish view modes and defaults; UI tests assert details and tile panels. Owner collection shard records implemented view controls and preserves SHOULD in H.

cells.source: Navigator required if C; Colors optional suggested; Sort optional; Folders required only if folders used; Split optional with fallback orientation conditional on View.
cells.implementation: Collection and navigator model feeds existing panel layouts, sort and folder tree.
cells.assertions: Covered by collections and collection-navigator shards. Split H/V/Position choices remain qualified optional-furniture policy; no universal obligation to provide a second preview pane is inferred.

cells.source: Type optional. Each other key names a field dictionary and must match the same key in a file's CI collection item.
cells.implementation: Collection parser maps schema keys; item parser uses CI keys; host column extraction joins the two.
cells.assertions: The current collection-schema exact-xref test uses matching Author/Received/Rank schema keys and CI values; positive controls prove one file population, literal FileName/Desc/Size and valid decoded payload.

cells.source: S/D/N are values in CI as string/date/number. File-related types source values from FileSpec or Table45. CompressedSize is PDF2 stream Length, and required equal to Length. Separately, Table43 says Desc shall be used for a FileSpec referenced from EmbeddedFiles.
cells.implementation: collection model parses field kinds and item values; `viewer-host::panel::column_value` currently maps file-related basic fields but does not produce CI values or CompressedSize in details view.
cells.assertions: Current exact-xref `collection_schema_cells_audit.rs` has independent CI Author/Ada Lovelace, Received/date, Rank/7 assertions and FileName/Desc/decoded Size controls; expected-failure registry retains B05 for the CI S/D/N cells and B06 for CompressedSize. B06 distinguishes compressed stream Length 11 from decoded Size 3 (literal abc). Do not duplicate these existing candidate tests; status of their current run is governed by current expected-failure/gate records, not this shard.

cells.source: N required heading presented to user; O optional order ascending; V defaults true; E defaults false and says whether interactive processor should support field-value editing.
cells.implementation: Host orders visible fields by O, filters V=false; E is carried but no editing UI is required by a SHOULD alone.
cells.assertions: Panel test checks custom order, visible/hidden cells and header text. No mandatory edit operation is inferred from E.

parent_execution: Wave108 integrated the corrected collection fixture: binary header, equal 16-byte initial IDs, required F, UTF-16BE UF, indirect CI, and exact-xref/no-chain-cut guards. Desc was already present. All four existing B05/B06 failures persist after positive Filename/Desc/decoded Size controls. No new behavior finding.
